encounter.text: There is nothing here but a rat sitting in the dark, perfectly still, facing the deepest part of the Abyss. When you get close enough, you see their eyes are open but unfocused — not the blankness of the spore cult, something older. They speak without turning. 'It knows you've been sealing its doors. It's waiting at the bottom now. Not hiding. Waiting.' A pause. 'It's been there since before the tunnels. It will be there after. The only question is whether you give it a reason not to come up.'
